title: Clinically Applicable Segmentation of Head and Neck Anatomy for Radiotherapy (normalized surface Dice)
mechanism: Surface Dice at tolerance tau, with tau set from measured inter-observer variation, scores boundaries as correct when within tau.
adaptation: tau = 2 px from our measured annotator agreement (0.82-0.99 within 2 px); NSD@1 and @2 for crack, @2 for inactive and thin structural classes (gridline, busbar). Use as decision metric only if it separates known real effects better than strict IoU.
min_experiment: Arm: NSD@1/2/3 on OOF predictions. Baseline: strict crack IoU. Metric: paired t statistic for 5-seed ensemble vs single model (known +0.014-0.018). Kill: NSD@2 t not higher than strict IoU t.
evidence: R: introduced surface Dice with organ-specific tolerances from inter-observer variation on head and neck CT.
prior_overlap: partial: relF1@2 (tolerance F1) is already reported; NSD as decision metric and per-class tau not tested.
